# ScribeCat 0.25.16

### PDF viewer
- Keep the PDF viewer as the only document preview surface for linked documents.
- Hide the inline PDF viewer toolbar after opening a PDF beside the note; show only the document name as a compact grey label.
- Restore the inline viewer correctly when the split PDF pane is closed.
- Stabilize multi-page PDF thumbnails by preserving each page's native aspect ratio.
- Restore fullscreen on mobile and arrange the mobile controls with the document name on top, paging left below, and fullscreen/zoom on the right.

### Import and editor media
- Keep PDF and image import/insertion.
- Remove Word and PowerPoint import support.
- Block external file drag-and-drop and file pasting into the editor.
- Keep DOCX export support.
